product_description: A single small white wooden dollhouse, three storeys with one pastel blue roof and a chimney, stands on the wooden floor on the left and casts a soft shadow. Directly above the roof of the dollhouse the grey sofa and the white wall are visible
scene: Photorealistic lifestyle photo of a bright, calm, tidy living room with a light grey sofa, a wooden floor and a large window with soft daylight. No other toys anywhere

persons.description: a girl with strawberry-blonde hair in a casual cotton sweater and trousers, sitting cross-legged on the floor right next to the dollhouse, looking at it happily, fully clothed
